steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Seems you've got a better sense of direction here than those from the Underground, huh?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You're the one marked by X, the Sinner S-012. Clearly, there's a glitch in the marking system.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Harnessing powers without furthering assimilation.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's because I have ironclad determination. I steered clear of my abilities for nine long years to escape your grip, sculpting my muscles into a powerhouse.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Actually, it's more like the original mark is beginning to falter.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Donald, as an S-Class Sinner, your feat of keeping your identity intact in the Black Ring is nothing short of astonishing. You're a powerhouse with a potential to make monumental contributions to humankind.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's a shame, though, the Hush who marked you had an untimely exit. If she was still around, she'd have been ideal for reining in your wayward tendencies.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Really? That Hush's been sidelined, huh... If only you'd told me sooner, I would've thrown caution to the wind.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Looks like her absence is throwing a wrench in your plans, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: So, what happened, got beaten by the Underground again?
Almost as if in reply to his statement, the High Tower trembles again.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Don't waste your effort trying to rile me up, Sinner. We embody pure reason.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Let's not have a showdown here. You two are already under the heavy strain of the Black Ring. Without the right stuff, you're just burning our time.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Our mission is to halt the Underground's advances and break the Black Ring, averting a global crisis. So, move aside.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Our aim is ${PlayerName}, all for the greater good of humanity.
As the knight advances, Donald swiftly moves you to the safety behind him.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Stay safe, ${PlayerName}. This thing might be junk, but the character next to it? Definitely not.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: This knight has waded through contamination to sweep this place clean, just lying in wait for us.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I'll say it again: Turn him over to Paradeisos.
steps.female_content: I'll say it again: Turn her over to Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Telling me a hundred times won't change a thing, beat it!
